question: From a tissue to which oligomycin is added, it can be expected that:

options.opb: Do not consume oxygen and produce ATP.
options.opc: Consume oxygen and do not produce ATP.
options.ope: Neither consume oxygen nor produce ATP.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Oligomycin" -> "inhibits ATP synthase" -> "proton gradient not used" -> "no ATP production" -> "oxygen consumption decreases" -> 85%
CHAIN: slows" -> "oxygen consumption decreases" -> "no ATP production" -> 90%
CHAIN: inhibited" -> "oxygen consumption stops" -> "no ATP production" -> 95%
CHAIN: slows" -> "possible residual oxygen consumption" -> "no ATP production" -> 75%
analysis: Oligomycin is an inhibitor of ATP synthase, a crucial enzyme in the mitochondrial electron transport chain responsible for ATP production. When oligomycin is added to a tissue, it blocks the proton channel of ATP synthase, preventing protons from flowing back into the mitochondrial matrix. This halts ATP production. However, the electron transport chain may continue to consume oxygen as electrons are transferred through the chain, but without ATP synthesis. Therefore, the tissue will consume oxygen but will not produce ATP.
